name: Fiberlogy (Fiberlab S.A.)
summary: Polish filament manufacturer near Krakow, trading as Fiberlogy under the legal entity Fiberlab S.A. Produces in-house in Poland with a 'Made in EU' marketing emphasis, and carries an unusually deep engineering and composite lineup (PCTG, PP, PA-CF) for its catalog size alongside decorative lines such as FiberSilk.

product_lines.name: PLA family
product_lines.notes: Easy PLA, Impact PLA and HD-PLA

product_lines.name: Soluble support
product_lines.notes: Water-soluble support material; exact chemistry (PVA vs BVOH) not confirmed

additional_notes: No evidence of white-labelling for other brands or of reselling, so no oem_relationships are recorded; Fiberlogy does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md. A directory listing under the name 'Fiberlab' refers to the same legal entity that owns the Fiberlogy brand, not a separate third-party OEM. Observed pricing: ASA roughly EUR 35-45/kg, PP roughly EUR 35-53/kg, PA12+CF roughly EUR 80-116/kg. A third-party review aggregator positions the brand between budget brands like eSUN and premium brands like Prusament, which reads as mid; 'premium' was chosen because the observed EUR/kg figures sit above mid-tier pricing - flagged as a judgment call. No build plates are advertised on the site (filament and spools only).

provenance.conflicts: price_tier: the review aggregator's 'between eSUN and Prusament' framing implies mid, while the EUR 35-116/kg observed pricing implies premium; 'premium' chosen, needs a Fable-level call. Soluble support chemistry mapped to 'pva' provisionally.
